title: Python Variables
description: Variables are containers for storing data values. In Python, a variable is created the moment you first assign a value to it.

challenges.title: Assign and Print
challenges.exercise: Create a variable named 'carName' and assign the value 'Volvo' to it. Then print it.

challenges.title: Variable Types
challenges.exercise: Create a variable 'x' with value 50 and print its type using type(x).

challenges.title: Multi-Assignment
challenges.exercise: Assign the values 'Orange', 'Banana', 'Cherry' to three variables x, y, z in one line. Then print y.

challenges.title: Math with Variables
challenges.exercise: Create variables a=5 and b=10. Print the sum of a and b.

challenges.title: Casting Master
challenges.exercise: Create a variable x = str(3) and y = int(3). Print the output of x*y.
challenges.solution:
x = str(3)
y = int(3)
print(x * y)
